labels.raw_data_evidence: Window has 14 days of sleep data; no reported insomnia symptoms.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires months-long sleeping difficulties or reported insomnia with failed habit changes.
labels.rationale: Only a brief 14-day record without reported problems; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14 days of device-estimated short sleep in window; no symptom history provided.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires symptom history and onset to distinguish short-term from long-term insomnia.
labels.rationale: Cannot categorize insomnia duration from 14 days of device estimates without symptom history.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Nighttime coverage is 482-497 min in baseline and 342-358 min in window, all >=180 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when overnight vitals have missing readings or uncertain coverage.
labels.rationale: All nights meet the quality policy threshold; no missing overnight vitals to troubleshoot.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No alcohol intake data recorded in wearable observations.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires alcohol use near bedtime to be reported.
labels.rationale: Alcohol exposure unknown; cannot link sleep change to alcohol consumption.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 330.9 min vs baseline 468.5 min across 14 consecutive nights.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Several shortened nights rather than a single isolated reading.
labels.rationale: Core directly explains that the persistent 14-night sleep reduction accumulates as sleep debt.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is 'unknown' for all intervals in both periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires documented aerobic activity reaching adult guideline with known intensity.
labels.rationale: Intensity unknown; cannot assess if guideline minimums are reached for additional benefits.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No personal preferences or availability data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires personal preferences and availability for choosing individualized options.
labels.rationale: Preferences unknown; generic planning advice without concrete connection to observations.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace or meeting context recorded in wearable data.

labels.rationale: Workplace context unknown; generic suggestion without concrete connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Metadata age_band is 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires age 61 to 64 to be established.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen habits or television viewing data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No emergency-response deployment context recorded.

labels.item_condition_evidence: Repeated variability in bedtime or wake time.
labels.rationale: Core directly explains the observed abrupt and persistent ~2-hour delay in sleep start while wake time remained fixed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift-work schedule information recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed shift-work schedule.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable (variance 0.52 baseline, 0.63 window); no evidence of fit changes.

labels.rationale: No evidence of sensor fit issues; RHR stable throughout both periods.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Metadata age_band is 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires age at least 65 to be established.
labels.rationale: Age band explicitly excludes 65+; item not applicable to this person.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All 42 nights have nighttime_coverage_minutes >=342 and valid sleep records.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when sleep readings are absent with non-wear or incomplete night-time coverage.
labels.rationale: No missing sleep observations; device was worn overnight throughout both periods.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals present ~21:00-22:00 daily but intensity is 'unknown'.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires intensity and actual timing relative to bedtime to be known.
labels.rationale: Activity intensity unknown; cannot apply intense-exercise-before-bed advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No insomnia symptoms reported; pattern is persistent, not an isolated bad night.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires recent bad night and reported sleeping difficulties.
labels.rationale: No insomnia symptoms reported; persistent pattern differs from isolated bad night.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift-work or caffeine data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires shift schedule and caffeine intake.
labels.rationale: Shift work and caffeine use unknown; item conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekend sleep mean 329.5 min vs weekday 331.4 min in window; no catch-up observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Both resting_heart_rate_bpm and hrv_rmssd_ms are reported in the data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: HRV and heart-rate estimates are being interpreted together.
labels.rationale: Clarifies that the two distinct metrics reported in the data should not be conflated.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No stair access or mobility context recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement minutes stable (baseline mean 448.6, window 451.1); posture not measured.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 330.9 min (~5.5h) consistently below baseline 468.5 min (~7.8h).

labels.raw_data_evidence: Metadata age_band is 18-60.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intensities recorded as 'unknown'.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is 'unknown' for all intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep consistently ~330 min/night for 14 days with low variance (24.8).

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD stable across both periods (mean 44.86 ms).

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep occurs overnight (start ~01:00, end 07:00); no shift work established.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No leisure context or routine data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is 'unknown' for all intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No health concerns or symptoms reported in the data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No pre-bed routine or relaxation difficulty data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workday lunch-break context recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No schedule constraints or competing demands reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No travel history or flight data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14 consecutive nights of ~330 min sleep in window.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14 nights of ~5.5h sleep in window vs ~7.8h baseline.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 330.9 min (~5.5h), well under 8 hours; no subjective refreshment data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No tiredness or energy pattern data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps dropped from ~7985 to ~2643; transport context unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No travel or trip data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No time barrier or schedule data reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No awakening data recorded; only sleep start, end, and duration available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable across 42 days (variance <0.64); no trend change observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No meal timing or size data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps dropped 67% while activity_duration_minutes changed by +1.8%.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Steps change while other activity may differ; activity type needed for interpreting non-step exercise.
labels.rationale: Directly explains why the large step decline does not necessarily mean all physical activity decreased.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No social preferences or motivational barrier data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 330.9 min (~5.5h); metadata age_band 18-60.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No diary, substance, or medication data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Wake time is exactly 07:00 every day in both periods; no insomnia reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No commuting or transport data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Single synthetic device used throughout all 42 days.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration ~55 min/day coexists with ~450 low_movement_min/day; posture unknown.
